_comment: Single source of truth for the guest-review figures shown on the site.
Every number here was read off the platform's own public listing on the
date in 'checked'. Nothing is estimated. Edit this file, then run
to push the figures into every page that shows them.
Ratings are shown to one decimal place; the site rating for a property is
the review-count-weighted mean of its sources, which is why Oxford reads
Do NOT put these figures into schema.org AggregateRating markup. Google's
structured-data policy does not allow a site to mark up ratings it has
gathered from other platforms. Visible on-page text is fine. The owner's
Repuso widget on theoaks.uk does emit that markup; we deliberately do not
A property with a 'live' block has its figures refreshed in the browser by
js/reviews-live.js, which reads the owner's own Repuso feed. The numbers
below are then the FALLBACK, shown when that fetch fails and to anyone
without JavaScript, so keep them roughly current even for a live property.
Dorset has no Repuso widget, so it stays manual.

note: The owner's own Repuso subscription, embedded on theoaks.uk as a Wix
custom-HTML block. Public JSON, no key, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
Its 'badge' array carries one entry per platform with a count and a
score; Repuso merges two Tripadvisor channels and two Airbnb channels,
which is why its per-platform totals run ahead of the single listings
counted below. Undocumented endpoint, so treat a failure as normal and
fall back rather than showing an error.

sources.listing: Whimsical Treehouse in C. S. Lewis' footsteps
